answer: Every claim climbs the mirror of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lagoon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, burned when the recruit misbehaves. Reaching the trellis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
